name: Guangzhou City
sources: Rivers and canals: OpenStreetMap contributors, via the Overpass API (ODbL)
Land cover: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200, 10 m (CC BY 4.0), via Microsoft Planetary Computer
Elevation: Copernicus DEM GLO-30, via Microsoft Planetary Computer
Surface temperature: Landsat 8-9 Collection 2 (USGS/NASA), via Microsoft Planetary Computer
notes: Dropped 1 small outlying parts of the outline, such as distant islands.
Population covers China only. Surrounding land in other countries counts as empty.
Hexes are large, so floodplains are only roughly placed.

heat_check.source: Landsat 8-9 Collection 2 surface temperature (USGS/NASA), via Microsoft Planetary Computer
heat_check.note: Daytime land surface temperature, about 10:30 local time, clear skies only.
